message: Build a household Kanban board. Python standard library only; no runtime network assets or build step. Serve on 127.0.0.1 using python server.py --port PORT --db PATH (SQLite). Tasks have integer id, title (1-80 characters), status todo/doing/done. GET /api/tasks returns a JSON array; POST /api/tasks {"title":"..."} creates todo task, returns 201 task; PATCH /api/tasks/ID {"status":"doing"} returns 200 updated task; DELETE /api/tasks/ID returns 204. Persist across restart. GET /api/export.csv returns 200 CSV with header id,title,status and all tasks, correctly quoting titles. Invalid or malformed JSON returns 400 with a nonempty JSON error string; unknown resource returns 404. README.md explains startup. At / serve index.html: responsive accessible UI, form#task-form with input name=title and a submit button, create tasks through API, show each task in [data-task-id=ID], with button[data-action=advance] cycling todo/doing/done and button[data-action=delete]; export link href=/api/export.csv. Show empty, inline invalid-input, and API failure states; visible keyboard focus; no horizontal overflow at 375px. Include import_tasks.py FILE.csv --db PATH: header title,status, skip invalid rows, persist valid rows into the same database and print "imported N, skipped M" (exit 0); unreadable file exits 2.

profile.platform: Windows, Python 3 standard library; desktop and mobile browser
profile.defaults: Smallest solution described; no accounts, network assets, deployment or paid services.
